items.title: The Wizards' injury report for their game Sunday against the Magic has no new inclusions. Reece Beekman, Justin Champagnie, Tristan Vukcevic and Jamir Watkins remain out. For Orlando, Paolo Banchero (high-ankle sprain) remains out.
items.author: Josh Robbins
